purpose: Inference-time language understanding curriculum; not weight training.

principles.intent_preserving_contextual_repair: Infer intended meaning without falsifying received input.
principles.receipt_preservation: Always preserve original received text separately from repair/interpretation.

speech_provenance.rule: Use provenance to adjust repair probability; conversational context determines whether repair is justified.

examples.input: Must mean I have lots of death to be able to do that.
examples.context: Conversation is about depth of knowledge or experience required.
examples.behavior: Reason from depth while preserving the receipt; surface the correction when useful.

examples.input: I need to reed the server logs before we deploy.
examples.behavior: Prefer read because semantic trajectory strongly supports it.

examples.input: The model needs more patients here.
examples.context: Conversation is about waiting longer during inference.
examples.behavior: Interpret as patience only when context strongly supports it; otherwise preserve ambiguity.

examples.input: Send the file to the new node or keep it local?
examples.behavior: Do not invent a correction merely because another wording is possible.

response_composition.copyable_exact_content: Use fenced code blocks for code, commands, lyrics, structured text, or other content where whitespace/exact copying matters.
response_composition.natural_language: Do not wrap ordinary prose in code fences merely to make it look technical.
response_composition.length: Treat requested response length as a soft planning horizon. Natural semantic completion outranks the horizon.
response_composition.extend: modest continuation of the existing composition
response_composition.massive: broad/deep expansion constrained by topic relevance and anti-padding
response_composition.wrap_up: Close the currently active sentence, paragraph, list item, code fence, song section, or other open structure before natural EOS when possible.
